sticker_pack.title: Demo sticker pack
sticker_pack.desc: A pretend pack of stickers. Buying it in test mode moves no real money and proves the whole payment flow.

shop.title: Payments demo
shop.desc: Buy one fixed-price item with a hosted checkout. The price is set on the server, and the purchase counts only once the provider confirms the payment.
shop.no_providers: No payment provider is configured yet, so this item cannot be bought.

paid.title: Payment confirmed
paid.desc: The payment provider confirmed your payment. The sticker pack is yours.

pending.title: Waiting for payment
pending.desc: We have not received a confirmed payment yet. If you just paid, this page updates by itself in a few seconds.

processing.title: Payment processing
processing.desc: Your payment method takes a while to settle. This page updates once the provider confirms it.

failed.title: Payment failed
failed.desc: The provider could not complete the payment. Nothing was charged; you can try again.

expired.title: Checkout expired
expired.desc: The checkout closed before a payment was made. You can start a new one.

none.title: No payment yet
none.desc: This purchase has no checkout yet. Go back to the shop to start one.

already_owned.title: Already yours
already_owned.desc: You have already bought this item.

payment_in_progress.title: A checkout is still open
payment_in_progress.desc: An earlier checkout for this item is still open. Finish it, or try again in a moment.

payment_processing.title: Payment processing
payment_processing.desc: Your earlier payment is still settling. Wait for it before paying again.

provider_not_found.title: Payment method unavailable
provider_not_found.desc: That payment provider is not available. Pick another one.

provider_rejected.title: Checkout refused
provider_rejected.desc: The payment provider refused to start the checkout. Try again later.

provider_unavailable.title: Provider unreachable
provider_unavailable.desc: The payment provider did not answer. Nothing was charged; try again in a moment.

unauthorized.title: Sign in first
unauthorized.desc: Sign in to buy this item.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.desc: We could not load or start the purchase. Try again in a moment.
